name: assimp/assimp
description: The Open Asset Import Library (Assimp) loads 40+ 3D file formats into one unified and clean data structure. Industry-standard C++ library widely used in game engines, editors, and converters.
score_rationale: Industry-standard 3D asset importer supporting 40+ formats, actively maintained with 12.8k stars and used across countless game engines and tools.

name: zeux/meshoptimizer
description: Mesh optimization library that makes meshes smaller and faster to render by optimizing vertex cache, overdraw, and vertex fetch, with built-in geometry compression. Includes gltfpack CLI for full glTF pipeline optimization.
score_rationale: Widely adopted, high-quality mesh compression and optimization library with 7.4k stars, MIT licensed, and actively maintained — essential for production asset pipelines.

name: BinomialLLC/basis_universal
description: Basis Universal is a supercompressed GPU texture codec that transcodes to virtually any GPU texture format at runtime, supporting ETC1S, UASTC, ASTC, BC7, and more. The de-facto standard for portable GPU texture distribution.
score_rationale: Dominant portable GPU texture compression standard with 3k stars, used in major game engines (Unity, Godot, Babylon.js), and backed by the KTX2 spec from Khronos.

name: donmccurdy/glTF-Transform
description: glTF 2.0 SDK for JavaScript and TypeScript (Node.js and Web) providing fast, reproducible, lossless control over low-level glTF model details including compression, optimization, and format conversion.
score_rationale: The go-to JS/TS toolchain for glTF asset processing with 1.8k stars, actively maintained, and widely used in web-based game and 3D tooling pipelines.

name: KhronosGroup/KTX-Software
description: Official Khronos KTX (Khronos Texture) library and tools for reading, writing, validating, encoding, and transcoding KTX texture files for OpenGL, Vulkan, and other GPU APIs.
score_rationale: Official Khronos implementation for the KTX2 open texture standard with 1.2k stars, actively maintained through 2025, and essential for modern GPU texture pipelines.

name: syoyo/tinygltf
description: Header-only C++11 library for loading and saving glTF 2.0 files, designed for easy integration with minimal dependencies. Used widely in game engines and research projects.
score_rationale: Extremely popular header-only glTF loader with 2.4k stars, MIT licensed, and the default choice for C++ projects needing lightweight glTF import.

name: azagaya/laigter
description: Laigter is a tool for automatically generating normal, parallax, specular, and occlusion maps for 2D sprites, with real-time in-game preview. Designed for indie game developers.
score_rationale: Actively maintained through December 2025 with 1.2k stars, uniquely targets 2D sprite map generation — a well-defined niche with a polished GUI tool.

name: nem0/OpenFBX
description: Lightweight open-source FBX importer that loads geometry, skeletons, animations, blend shapes, materials, textures, cameras, and lights without the proprietary Autodesk SDK.
score_rationale: Only practical open-source pure-C FBX importer with 1.3k stars, used in both Lumix Engine and Flax Engine, though development slowed after 2021.

name: odrick/free-tex-packer
description: Free texture packer and sprite sheet generator supporting rotation, trimming, multipacking, and export to json, xml, pixi.js, godot, phaser, and cocos2d formats.
score_rationale: Popular sprite atlas tool with 1.2k stars and broad engine export support, though it is no longer actively maintained as of 2021.

name: amethyst/distill
description: Asset pipeline system for game engines that reads artist-friendly source formats, processes them into engine-ready formats, handles dependency tracking, hot-reloading, and asset packing for shipping.
score_rationale: Well-architected Rust asset pipeline with 373 stars addressing the full production pipeline use case, though development is tied to the now-inactive Amethyst engine project.

name: BinomialLLC/crunch
description: Advanced DXTn texture compression library and tool providing lossy compression for DXT1/5/N and 3DC formats, enabling transcoding at 100-250 megatexels/sec for game texture pipelines.
score_rationale: Historically significant DXT compression tool with 895 stars; now archived but still referenced as a baseline for DXTn compression techniques.

name: microsoft/glTF-SDK
description: Microsoft's C++ SDK for reading and writing glTF and glb files with schema validation, embedded Base64 support, and cross-platform compatibility (Windows, macOS, Android).
score_rationale: Solid C++ glTF SDK with 608 stars from Microsoft, but largely inactive since 2022 and superseded by smaller focused libraries for most use cases.

name: cpetry/NormalMap-Online
description: Browser-based normal map generator that runs entirely locally using WebGL, converting diffuse/height images into normal maps without any server uploads.
score_rationale: Handy browser-based normal map tool with 533 stars, widely linked by artists, though it is a simple utility rather than a production pipeline component.

name: GameTechDev/ISPCTextureCompressor
description: Intel ISPC-based texture compression library supporting BC6H, BC7, ASTC, ETC1, and BC4/BC5 formats using SIMD CPU optimization for high-speed offline compression.
score_rationale: Historically useful SIMD texture compressor with 470 stars, but archived by Intel in September 2024 with no further maintenance planned.

name: Theverat/NormalmapGenerator
description: Qt-based desktop application that converts images into normal maps with multithreading support and a 'Keep Large Detail' blending mode for preserving overall curvature.
score_rationale: Functional normal map tool with 476 stars but abandoned since 2017 with no recent activity or community maintenance.

name: amakaseev/sprite-sheet-packer
description: Qt-based GUI and CLI sprite sheet packer supporting multiple resolutions, batch packing, and transparency trimming across macOS, Windows, and Linux.
score_rationale: Reasonable sprite sheet tool with 329 stars but abandoned since 2017 and lacking modern engine export formats compared to alternatives.

name: microsoft/glTF-Toolkit
description: Collection of C++ tools and libraries for modifying and optimizing glTF assets, including texture packing, compression, mesh LOD merging, and a command-line converter for Windows Mixed Reality.
score_rationale: Narrowly scoped to Windows Mixed Reality with 316 stars and no commits since 2019, making it largely obsolete for general use.

name: jrbedard/3d-converter
description: Fast C++ command-line 3D file format converter supporting OBJ, 3DS, MA, MB, XSI, LWO, DXF, STL, and DAE formats.
score_rationale: Lightweight format converter with 179 stars covering legacy formats, but appears unmaintained and lacks support for modern formats like glTF or USD.

name: mapeditor/tiled
description: Tiled is a flexible, general-purpose tile map and level editor for tile-based games (RPGs, platformers, etc.), supporting orthogonal, isometric, and hexagonal maps with a rich TMX format.
score_rationale: 12.4k stars, the industry-standard tile map editor with 15+ years of active development, March 2026 release, and near-universal adoption in 2D game development.

name: piskelapp/piskel
description: A simple web-based pixel art and sprite animation editor with live preview, built entirely in JavaScript. Supports export to GIF, PNG spritesheet, and ZIP, and runs as a desktop app.
score_rationale: 12.4k stars, widely used free web-based sprite editor beloved by game jammers and indie devs for quick pixel art creation.

name: LibreSprite/LibreSprite
description: LibreSprite is a free, open-source animated sprite editor and pixel art tool, forked from the last GPL-licensed version of Aseprite. Supports layers, frames, onion skinning, and multiple platforms.
score_rationale: 7.4k stars, the leading free/open-source alternative to Aseprite for pixel art, with active development and broad platform support.

name: aseprite/aseprite
description: Aseprite is the leading animated sprite editor and pixel art tool (source-available, EULA license) for Windows, macOS, and Linux. Supports layers, animations, onion skinning, and many export formats.
score_rationale: 36.2k stars, the de-facto industry standard pixel art tool with source code available — massively used by indie game developers worldwide despite its EULA license.

name: deepnight/ldtk
description: LDtk is a modern, lightweight, and efficient 2D level editor from the director of Dead Cells, with strong focus on user-friendliness and a clean JSON-based level format.
score_rationale: 3.9k stars, a widely loved 2D level editor with a clean format adopted across many game engines and frameworks, especially in the indie scene.

name: TrenchBroom/TrenchBroom
description: TrenchBroom is a modern, cross-platform level editor for Quake-engine-based games, supporting Quake 1, 2, and Hexen 2 with true 3D editing and precise brush manipulation.
score_rationale: 2.5k stars, the definitive open-source editor for classic Quake-engine games with active January 2026 releases and a dedicated retro FPS community.

name: Ogmo-Editor-3/OgmoEditor3-CE
description: OGMO Editor 3 Community Edition is an open-source, project-oriented 2D level editor made for indie game developers, supporting tile layers, entity layers, and JSON level export.
score_rationale: 573 stars, a well-regarded free level editor in the indie community with good multi-layer support, though modest adoption compared to Tiled and LDtk.

name: BehaviorTree/BehaviorTree.CPP
description: A battle-tested C++17 behavior tree library used extensively in robotics and game AI. Supports XML-defined trees loaded at runtime, async actions, reactive execution, and built-in logging.
score_rationale: Industry-standard BT library in C++ with 3.9k stars, active maintenance through 2026, and broad adoption in both robotics and game AI.

name: Tencent/behaviac
description: A game AI development framework from Tencent supporting behavior trees, finite state machines, and hierarchical task networks with a visual editor for rapid prototyping.
score_rationale: 3k stars, built and maintained by Tencent for production game AI, covers BT+FSM+HTN in one framework with a visual editor.

name: bitbrain/beehave
description: A powerful behavior tree addon for the Godot 4 engine that lets designers build complex NPC AI, boss battles, and agent behaviors using a node-based visual workflow.
score_rationale: 3k stars and actively maintained through late 2025; the go-to behavior tree solution for Godot developers.

name: limbonaut/limboai
description: A C++ plugin for Godot Engine 4 combining behavior trees and hierarchical state machines with an integrated visual editor and debugger for complex NPC AI.
score_rationale: 2.6k stars, actively maintained through March 2026, provides both BT and HSM in a single well-documented Godot plugin.

name: crashkonijn/GOAP
description: A robust multi-threaded Goal Oriented Action Planning (GOAP) system for Unity with a visual debugger, enabling complex NPC AI behaviors through automatic action planning.
score_rationale: 1.7k stars, actively maintained through 2026, provides production-ready multi-threaded GOAP for Unity with strong debugging tooling.
